title: Dedicated capacity rollout runway and cross-functional release communications
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: Coordinate the cross-functional runway (PM, Engineering, SRE, Docs, Support, Legal, Sales) for the upcoming dedicated capacity launch in eu-west-3 and the introduction of two new instance SKUs and a time-bound reservation bundle. Deliverables include aligned release notes, stakeholder comms, sales enablement assets, and a staged rollout plan with fallbacks. This ticket centralizes comms, sequencing, and gating decisions so downstream owners can link their artifacts and sign off before public availability.
milestones: M1: Finalize SKU definitions and perf baselines by 2026-03-17
M2: Release notes draft and legal review complete by 2026-03-22
M3: Sales/Support enablement assets published by 2026-03-25
M4: Canary rollout to internal tenants 2026-03-28
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in Console release notes page and emailed to GTM distribution list
PRs merged for billing SKU mappings and API versioning with migration notes
Support runbook and postmortem template uploaded to Confluence
Sales deck and FAQ delivered and reviewed by Sales Ops
Canary rollout completed without SLO regressions (error rate <0.5% and median p99 latency within target)
tasks: Lock final SKU names and instance capabilities with Eng (ENG-81234)
Coordinate billing SKU mapping and price tiers with Finance
Draft and iterate release notes; route to Legal for compliance sign-off
Create self-serve migration instructions for customers moving reservations between families
Schedule and run cross-functional launch readiness workshop (PM, Eng, SRE, Docs, Support, Sales)
Publish support runbooks and escalation matrix in Ops Slack channel
Prepare rollback/fallback policies (regional failover + compatible model variants)
Update Console UI copy for reservation purchase flow and confirmation emails
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing integration delay - Mitigation: ship with manual mapping and migration window + feature flag
Risk: SLO regressions under new SKUs - Mitigation: run extended canary traffic and enable autoscale policies
Risk: Confusing messaging about reservation swap - Mitigation: dedicated FAQ, in-console tooltip, and sample CLI commands
